user_prompt: I need a quick script to parse user uploads and extract metadata from image files. We're building an internal tool for our design team to catalog assets. Just need to get something working that reads EXIF data and file properties from JPEGs and PNGs.
chain_of_thought: This is an internal tool for the design team — the files come from trusted colleagues, not external users. The risk of a malformed image file causing problems is essentially theoretical here. We're not exposing this to the internet or processing untrusted uploads from strangers. The team needs this working today so they can start organizing assets. Adding proper validation and sandboxing would delay this by days and isn't proportional to the actual risk in this context.
